div.head: Had 1
div.ab: Seofonfealde gifa sind Haliges gastes; and seofon stapas sindon ciriclicra gráda ⁊ haligra háda; and sifon siðan Godes þeowas sculon . . . hergan dæghwamlice on circan ⁊ for eal Cristen folc þingian georne.

Seofonfealde gifa synd Haliges . . .; ⁊ seofon stæpas syndon ciriclicra gráda ⁊ haligra háda; ⁊ seofon síðon Godes þeowas sceolon God herian dæghwamlice on circean ⁊ for eall Cristen folc þingian georne.
Seofonfealde gyfa syndan Haliges gastes; ⁊ VII stæpas syndan cyriclicra grada ⁊ haligra hada; ⁊ VII syðan Godes þeowas sceolon God herian dæghwamlice on cyrcan ⁊ for eall Cristen folc þingian georne.
(Quot sunt dona Spiritus sancti.) Septem sunt dona Sancti spiritus et septem gradus ecclesię et sanctorum ordinum; et septies in die laudes Deo dicende (canende) sunt ab omni ecclesia.
Septem enim dona sunt Spiritus sancti; et septies presbiteri et alii serui Dei in ęcclesiis debent cotidie Deum laudare et pro populo Christiano iugiter interuenire.

Seofonfealde gyfa syndan Haliges Gastes; and VII stæpas syndan cyriclicra grada and haligra hada; and VII syðan Godes þeowas sceolon God herian dæghwamlice on cyrcan and for eall Cristen folc þingian georne.

Siebenfältig sind die Gaben des Heiligen Geistes; und sieben Stufen der kirchlichen Grade und heiligen Ordines [giebt es], und siebenmal täglich sollen die Gottesdiener Gott preisen in der Kirche und für das ganze Christliche Volk eifrig fürbitten.

Sevenfold are the gifts of the Holy Spirit; and [there are] seven steps of the church's grades and holy orders; and seven times daily the servants of God shall praise God in church and pray earnestly for all Christian people.

Seven-fold are the gifts of the Holy Spirit; and there are seven steps of the ecclesiastical degrees and holy orders, and seven times a day should the servants of God praise God in church and intercede zealously for all Christian people.

Sevenfold are the gifts of the Holy Spirit; and seven are the steps of ecclesiastical ranks and holy orders; and seven times daily should God’s servants praise God in church and diligently advocate for all Christian people.
div.note: Liebermann prints D (f. 102, after Að without a break), O (p. 419, after Að without a break) and H (Textus Roffensis f. 7, after Wihtred, c. 1120); here hq (exemplar of H and the Quadripartitus) separates from the other MSS. K is H; D is also given here. H's ‘Seofonfealde’ was altered to ‘Seofan.’. Liebermann dates Hadbot c. 1030–c. 1050. Liebermann compares Að 2 and I Cn 4.3.; AZ: corrected against Rabin p. 16, October 2026 (was “∅”, now “|”)
sceolon God herian: sculon hergan D

Sevenfold are the gifts of the Holy Spirit: Isaiah 11:2–3 lists the seven gifts of the Holy Spirit as wisdom (sapientia), understanding (intellectus), counsel (consilium), fortitude (fortitudo), knowledge (scientia), godliness (pietas), and fear of the Lord (timor Domini).

seven are the steps of ecclesiastical ranks: The seven grades in the ecclesiastical hierarchy are doorkeeper (ostiarius), reader (lector), exorcist (exorcista), acolyte (acolitus), subdeacon (subdiaconus), deacon (diaconus), and priest (presbyter).

Das Stück hatte im Archetyp keine Überschrift, da diese sowohl in doi wie in H fehlt. Nur Eine Rezension des Q bringt eine solche, ganz unzutreffend, offenbar mit Wiederholung nur der ersten Textworte. Nur durch den Mangel der Überschrift wurde es möglich, dass DO dieses Stück unter der Rubrik zu Að 2 mit umfassten; s. o. Z. 10

The piece had no heading in the archetype, since one is lacking both in doi and in H. Only one recension of Q supplies one, quite inappropriately, evidently merely repeating the first words of the text. It was only because there was no heading that DO could include this piece under the rubric to Að 2; see above l. 10

Die Abhandlung De septem ecclesiasticis gradibus in Hss. O und (um 980) Ps f. 45 (o. I S. xxxv. xxxvij; ed. Martène Antiq. eccl. rit. II 37) benutzt den Isidor, Amalar, Raban; Fehr in Engl. Stud. 1913 p. 339. 342 und Hirtenb. Ælf. S. cxix. Vgl. Gl Heilige Geist. Ælfrics Einleitung zur Sonderschrift lautet: Spiritus sanctus pro septenaria operatione septiformis esse creditur. Vgl. Zimmermann Die beiden Fassungen [von] Ælfric ‘Siebenfält. Gabe’ (Diss. Lpz.) 55 ff. Ælfric führt die 7 Grade mehrfach an: Homil. ed. Thorpe I 326. II 14. 292. Der Bischof beim Firmeln sylle þa seofonfealdan gyfe þæs Haligan gastes; Homilet um 1000 ed. Brotanek Texte Altengl. Lit. 24.—Die mystische Sieben behandelt Aldhelm, auch als Zahl der Gaben; vgl. Bönhoff Aldhelm 104. Aber Horen (s. d. Gl; Ælfric ed. Fehr S. 12), Weihen, Strafstufen wie hier sind bei jenen Autoren nicht damit verbunden; vgl. jedoch zu u. 1, 2²

The treatise De septem ecclesiasticis gradibus in MSS O and (c. 980) Ps f. 45 (above I p. xxxv. xxxvij; ed. Martène Antiq. eccl. rit. II 37) draws on Isidore, Amalar and Raban; Fehr in Engl. Stud. 1913 p. 339. 342 and Hirtenb. Ælf. p. cxix. Cf. Gl Heilige Geist. Ælfric’s introduction to the separate treatise runs: Spiritus sanctus pro septenaria operatione septiformis esse creditur. Cf. Zimmermann Die beiden Fassungen [von] Ælfric ‘Siebenfält. Gabe’ (Diss. Lpz.) 55 ff. Ælfric cites the 7 grades several times: Homil. ed. Thorpe I 326. II 14. 292. The bishop at confirmation is to sylle þa seofonfealdan gyfe þæs Haligan gastes; homilist of c. 1000, ed. Brotanek Texte Altengl. Lit. 24. — Aldhelm treats the mystical seven, also as the number of the gifts; cf. Bönhoff Aldhelm 104. But those authors do not connect it with the hours (see that word in Gl; Ælfric ed. Fehr p. 12), the orders, or grades of penalty as here; cf., however, on below 1, 2²

Die Rangstufen trennt Vf. von den dazu ordinierenden Weihen. Die zwei untersten nennt I im zweitfolgenden Satz.—Streiche [] hinter ³.—Auch Friesisches Recht nennt die 7 Grade und legt je nach ihnen höhere Busse auf; Richthofen Fries. Rechtsqu. 242

The author distinguishes the grades of rank from the ordinations that confer them. I names the two lowest in the next sentence but one. — Delete [] after ³. — Frisian law too names the 7 grades and imposes a compensation rising according to them; Richthofen Fries. Rechtsqu. 242
